questions.question: The modern Olympic Games were revived in 1896 at:
questions.rationale: Pierre de Coubertin's revival began in Athens in 1896, honouring the Games' Greek birthplace at ancient Olympia (from 776 BCE).

questions.question: The five interlocking rings of the Olympic symbol represent:
options: Five sports of the ancient Games
questions.rationale: The rings stand for the union of the five inhabited continents, with colours chosen so that every national flag of the era contained at least one.

questions.question: India's hockey team has won how many Olympic gold medals?
questions.rationale: Eight golds (1928-1980), beginning with Amsterdam 1928 and including six consecutive titles through 1956 — a record for any team sport.

questions.question: The first individual Olympic medal for independent India was won by:
questions.rationale: Wrestler K.D. Jadhav took bronze at Helsinki 1952. Pritchard's two silvers (1900) predate independence; Bindra's gold (2008) came first among individuals.

questions.question: Neeraj Chopra won India's first athletics gold at which Games?
questions.rationale: His javelin gold at Tokyo 2020 (held 2021) was independent India's first athletics gold; he added a silver at Paris 2024.

questions.question: The International Olympic Committee (IOC) is headquartered in:
questions.rationale: The IOC sits in Lausanne, Switzerland. FIFA's Zurich is the usual decoy for the city-pair question.

questions.question: The first Asian Games (1951) were held at:
questions.rationale: New Delhi hosted the inaugural Asiad in 1951 — and again in 1982, making it the first city to host the Games twice.

questions.question: At Paris 2024, Manu Bhaker became the first Indian to:
options: Win two medals at a single post-independence Olympics
Win a medal in pistol events
questions.rationale: Her individual bronze and the 10 m air pistol mixed-team bronze (with Sarabjot Singh) made her the first Indian double-medallist at one Games since independence.

questions.question: India hosted the Commonwealth Games for the first time in:
questions.rationale: Delhi 2010 remains India's only CWG hosting — and its best finish, second in the medal table led by the shooters.

questions.question: The Olympic motto was extended in 2021 with which word?
questions.rationale: 'Citius, Altius, Fortius' gained '- Communiter' (Together) in 2021, the first change to the motto in over a century.
